title: Wayfarer's Toolkit
description: GM tools for dnd5e: overland hex travel with off-road encounter rolls, flight routes with fares paid from a party purse (players can book flights too, with an optional departure sound), a session-start helper, MMO-style grey vendor-trash loot pre-rolled on every NPC and lootable when it dies, matched to the creature and scaled by CR (lootable bodies with Item Piles, richer drops in dungeon scenes), a riding feat, a classic-MMO-style character pane for equipping gear, a narrative quest log with an on-screen tracker, classic-MMO-style boss health frames, Need / Greed / Pass loot rolls for items in Item Piles piles, boss loot drawn from a roll table you link to a creature, and an optional three-coin economy (copper, silver, gold at 100 to 1). Your campaign content stays in your world; the module supplies the logic. Every tool can be turned on or off per world.

recommends.reason: Vendor Trash and Boss loot turn defeated creatures into lootable piles; Loot rolls hand out items from piles with Need / Greed / Pass.
Sets Item Piles up for dnd5e, which Vendor Trash's lootable piles need.
